column1: # verge-core - the daily hot-tier port set (v1 spec 3.5, ADR-0009).
# A union: frequency-set (cup) sensitive-list. Fields: port<TAB>transport<TAB>half.
# The frequency half is operator-editable (via the UI, TCP only); the sensitive
# half is authored by the project and ships in the release - moving one moves a
# version and Breaks the estate, so it is never operator-editable (3.5).
# deletions, plus 2.3's supplement, less 161/tcp and 623/tcp (ADR-0009): 123 TCP.
# Sensitive half: docs/research/sensitive-ports.md 3 as amended: 38 pairs
# (ADR-0067). golden_test.go holds each half to its section; edit the note first.
# Composed: 136 pairs (131 TCP, 5 UDP). Only TCP pairs are probed by default;
# UDP is off (connect-outcome cannot decide an honest UDP value - ADR-0083).
